sources.title: Council of Europe — CEFR global scale
sources.claim: A1 focuses on supported basic personal exchanges; A2 on familiar routine exchanges. B1 and B2 increase connectedness, autonomy and argumentation.
sources.limit: No prescribed French vocabulary list or certification of these lessons.

sources.title: Council of Europe — CEFR Companion volume (2020)
sources.claim: Goods/services (printed pp. 77–78) separate basic A1 requests, routine A2 transactions and B1 complaints; correspondence/messages (pp. 82–84) support short A2 practical messages.
sources.limit: Selected scales inspected, not an exhaustive descriptor alignment. Predictable supported issue reporting must not be equated with negotiating a dispute.

sources.title: Council of Europe — Reference Level Descriptions
sources.claim: The framework is language independent; language-specific descriptions are produced by national teams. The page points to the Eaquals/CIEP inventory.
sources.limit: Full French reference-level volumes were not inspected.

sources.title: Eaquals / CIEP / Eurocentres / ACPLS — Inventaire linguistique des contenus clés (2015)
sources.claim: Introduction and level summaries inform a language-specific grammar/function cross-check; the selected A2 transaction passage (printed p. 19) explicitly includes a simple bank exchange.
sources.limit: Guidance, not a compulsory syllabus or exhaustive word list. Introduction, contents, A1/A2 summaries and selected bank-related passages inspected; no full lexical audit.

sources.title: TV5MONDE — Première classe
sources.claim: Beginner pathways group introductions/family/origins, leisure, housing, meals, work, health and travel around everyday actions.
sources.limit: Overview inspected; not every exercise or a word-by-word level inventory.

sources.title: TV5MONDE — Grammaire / Avoir mal à
sources.claim: A1 examples use avoir mal à la / au / aux with body locations.
sources.limit: Language pattern only; no diagnosis, treatment or complete health-bank validation.

sources.title: TV5MONDE — Les meubles et les couleurs
sources.claim: A1 descriptive vocabulary includes masculine/feminine colour pairs and invariable marron.
sources.limit: Specific forms support usage review, not a compulsory colour inventory.

sources.title: Hachette FLE — Cosmopolite 1, publisher-hosted contents
sources.claim: Opening combines introductions, spelling, numbers and classroom language; subsequent tasks integrate place, daily life, meals, purchases and travel.
sources.limit: Five-page overview inspected; SmartLingo sequence/examples remain original.

sources.title: Hachette FLE — Cosmopolite 2, publisher-hosted contents
sources.claim: A2 course themes connect travel/accommodation, administration, experience, job seeking and practical instructions with communicative projects.
sources.limit: Four-page overview inspected. Its more demanding grammar is not automatically a prerequisite for SmartLingo A2 or a reason to copy its sequence.

sources.title: CLE International — Vocabulaire progressif, débutant A1
sources.claim: Publisher labels this adult/adolescent resource A1 and lists communicative activities such as invitations, directions and recipes.
sources.limit: Public resource labels only; recordings and proprietary exercises not downloaded or copied.

sources.title: CLE International — Vocabulaire progressif, intermédiaire A2/B1
sources.claim: Public activity labels revisit daily life, employment and clothing in an explicitly mixed A2/B1 resource.
sources.limit: Not evidence that all its vocabulary or tasks belong at A2. No underlying audio/exercises inspected.

sources.title: Académie française — Questions de langue, Nombres / Rectifications de l’orthographe
sources.claim: Vingt loses plural s before another numeral; traditional and rectified hyphenation are valid. Metropolitan usage includes soixante-dix / quatre-vingts / quatre-vingt-dix.
sources.limit: Selected number sections inspected; no pronunciation audio or whole-curriculum dictionary audit.

sources.title: FIPF / DramaFLE — Les chèques, A2 teaching activity overview
sources.claim: A2 banking-context activity combines a bounded practical task, information exchange, questions and banking vocabulary.
sources.limit: Overview only; underlying audio, exercises and cheque procedure not reused or validated as current advice. Together with Eaquals, supports bounded banking-task design, not the exact new charge-clarification vocabulary or its level.

sources.title: Larousse — débiter (de débit)
sources.claim: Confirms the banking sense of débiter as entering a sum on the debit side of an account.
sources.limit: Lexical usage only; no banking procedure, rights, deadline or refund guarantee.
